$note: Recovery commitments (CC 3.2 T3, CC 4.2.6, rc20): digest = SHA-256(CDE(['CEG-recovery/2', keys])), carried as [-16, digest] (commitment_cde_hex). keys is a set of ceg-key {1: 7, 3: -70100, -1: pub}, sorted by the bytewise order of each key's deterministic encoding, no duplicate. Keys are the accord-halt KAT roster (seeds a1/1a, b1/1b, c1/1c). Generated by gen_recovery_commitment.py with dilithium-py and pyca/cryptography, independent of verify.

cases.description: A1's per-holder recovery commitment: one key (CC 4.2.6).
A1, B1 and C1 given in descending encoding order; the set sorts them.
The same three in a third order: the same set, so the same digest.
A1 given twice: the set holds it once, so the digest is one_key's.
